description: Defines data structures and functions related to function schemas in the PyTorch JIT compiler, including Argument and FunctionSchema classes, with methods for schema compatibility, alias analysis, and serialization.

classes.name: Argument
classes.description: Represents a function argument with name, type, default value, alias info, and flags for kwarg and out argument.

classes.name: SchemaArgument
classes.description: Represents an argument or return in a function schema, with type (input/output) and index.

classes.name: FunctionSchema
classes.description: Encapsulates a function's schema including name, arguments, return types, and compatibility checks.

methods.name: Argument::operator==
methods.description: Checks equality between two Argument objects.

methods.name: Argument::isBackwardCompatibleWith
methods.description: Determines if this argument is backward compatible with an old argument.

methods.name: Argument::isForwardCompatibleWith
methods.description: Checks if this argument is forward compatible with an old argument.

methods.name: FunctionSchema::isBackwardCompatibleWith
methods.description: Checks if this schema is backward compatible with another schema.

methods.name: FunctionSchema::isForwardCompatibleWith
methods.description: Checks if this schema is forward compatible with another schema.

methods.name: FunctionSchema::checkSchema
methods.description: Validates the schema's argument list for correctness.

methods.name: operator<< (Argument)
methods.description: Serializes an Argument to an output stream in schema format.

methods.name: operator<< (FunctionSchema)
methods.description: Serializes a FunctionSchema to an output stream.
